subject.title: fix(ios): keep offline chat sends on their original route

question: Is the fail-closed legacy outbox upgrade contract acceptable for this PR, including parking unsafe queued rows for explicit retry and requiring the new routing-contract gateway capability for automatic replay?
rationale: The patch appears correct, but it intentionally changes persisted user-message state and replay behavior during upgrade, so maintainer intent is needed before treating the compatibility risk as accepted.

options.title: Accept fail-closed upgrade
options.body: Merge with the current migrations and routing capability gate, accepting explicit retry over automatic replay for unsafe legacy rows.

options.title: Require more upgrade proof
options.body: Pause until additional before/after upgrade evidence covers v2, v3, v4 outbox databases and an older-gateway replay attempt.

options.title: Narrow the follow-up
options.body: Split or defer macOS/shared schema hardening if maintainers want a smaller iOS-only route-binding change after the already-landed outbox.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed upgrade
recommendation.body: Merge with the current migrations and routing capability gate, accepting explicit retry over automatic replay for unsafe legacy rows.
